√śap 'curse'
present: [1.] śápati etc. V.+ śápate etc. B.+ -- [4.] śapyati śapyate 
perfect: śaśā́[a śepus AV.+ śepé etc. V.+ 
aorist: [3.] aśīśapat -- [4.] śāpta (2p.) aśapta 
future: [1.] śapiṣye śapsyati śapsyate -- [2.] śaptā 
verbal: śapta B.+ śapita śapitum śaptum śaptvā śapitvā 
secondary: passive: śapyate -- intensive: śaṅśap- -- desiderative: śiśapsa- -- causative: śāpayati etc. AV.+ 
derivatives: śāpa E.+ śápana AV. śapaná ŚB. śaptṛ́ AV. śapátha V.+

√sap 'serve'
present: [1.] sápati sápate etc. 
perfect: sepus 
aorist: [3.] sīṣapanta 
[future: sapiṣyati sapitā ]
secondary: causative: sāpáyant? 
derivatives: -sāp sápa B.S. -sapin RV. sapar- V.+ sápti V.+ 
The relations of part of these forms are very doubtful.
